decisions.notes: One detached charcoal-sleeved hand holds one matching ivory/black/rose mask. Single drawn wall and safe mask contours support S01/S02/S03/S35 inserts; no complete person or writing.

Empty illustrated medieval riverside complex without modern clock tower. S04 establishes a generic period palace/chapel setting only; cross finials and gables are artistic evocation, not authenticated Westminster geometry.
Empty closed oak entrance and one candle window; both are visible and separable for S05/S06 inserts. One drawn setting, no readable text or people.

Exactly one correctly identified Fawkes, clear boot/hand/barrel/hoop/face crop coverage for S13–S18 and unchanged closed barrels for S28. Ground-floor storage evocation, no lit fuse/fire. Partially obscured stacks imply storage; do not claim 36 visibly counted barrels.

One lead guard holds one blank creased sheet, one anonymous sender hand touches its corner. Supports S19–S21 handoff/read/reaction; preserve one paper and close crop rather than require an unseen pristine sealed letter. Sender identity remains unknown.
One lead guard with one lantern before a closed oak door; latch, arch and left hinges are visible. Covers S22/S23 prior to door opening, not arrest. Safe hands and clear one-action latch route.

One lead guard and one ajar custody oak door with square barred inspection opening; empty gap, no prisoner depiction. S29 supports door-closing transition; later candle scene must match door material/iron shapes.
One hand holds one closed dark book with mask motif and visible page edges/spine; no title or letters. S31 is a symbolic literary reference, not a reproduction of a published cover.
One round-headed anonymous charcoal-hoodie adult holds one matching mask below the uncovered face. Ready for S32 raising action; facial mask is not already worn. Both hands and prop distinct.
Reject: background is historical/domed/spired instead of contemporary, and the left role shoe crosses the frame boundary.
Reject: plan depicts the later neo-Gothic Parliament/clock tower rather than a simple medieval building outline; person identities/count and props otherwise read.

scope: Individual scenes; whole reference stage remains draft
